description: Stable minimal starter contracts for mechanical personalization unit tests. These are test-owned examples, independent of mutable consumer application files; real template build coverage belongs to the integration rehearsal.

files.backend/src/main/resources/application.y:
spring:
  application:
    name: vireocode-backend
  datasource:
    url: ${DATABASE_URL}
    username: ${DATABASE_USERNAME}
    password: ${DATABASE_PASSWORD}
  jpa:
    hibernate:
      ddl-auto: validate
  flyway:
    enabled: true
  session:
    jdbc:
      initialize-schema: never

server:
  servlet:
    context-path: /api
files.backend/compose.yaml:
name: vireocode-web-app-starter-local

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:18
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?Set POSTGRES_PASSWORD in backend/.env}
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql
volumes:
  postgres-data:
files.backend/.env.example:
COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=vireocode-web-app-starter-local
POSTGRES_DB=vireocode
POSTGRES_USER=vireocode
# Passwords remain empty in source control.
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=
POSTGRES_PORT=55436
INITIAL_USER_USERNAME=admin
INITIAL_USER_EMAIL=admin@example.com
INITIAL_USER_DISPLAY_NAME=Local Administrator
INITIAL_USER_PASSWORD=
files.README.md:
# VireoCode Web App Starter

A single-repository starter with a Java Spring Boot backend and a Vite React
TypeScript frontend. Manual paired GHCR/Hetzner release workflows require the
explicit operator setup below; copying this template does not deploy an app.

## Preserved setup guidance

Keep credentials private and preserve existing databases. This sentinel paragraph
represents application-owned guidance beyond the identity introduction.
files.frontend/README.md:
# RGO frontend application

This application was created from the RGO frontend template. It uses Node 24
and npm 12.0.2; run `npm ci` before development.

## Preserved development guidance

Retain the library attribution and setup instructions below the introduction.
